scope: Phase D consolidation queue persistence/lifecycle (no provider execution/candidate/publish/UI)
behavior: enqueue allocates jobId/permissionId, builds manifest/InputSnapshot through inputs, writes batch permission, job row and canonical input in one store transaction
idempotent request replay returns the same JobRef; same request id with different caller payload is OPERATION_CONFLICT
expected epoch/scopeRevision/headRevision are checked before job creation; excerpts mode refused until wired
pending/get/list with bounded limit/cursor; per-scope queued+running capacity 2
cancel is terminal/idempotent and clears consolidation_inputs; recoverInterrupted turns running into outcome_unknown and clears inputs
source/subject bodies remain absent from authority; manifest/route/policy digests and input chars are pinned in the job row
limitations: No runJob/provider purpose/prompt/candidate/publish/discard/confirmRemoteQuiescence; no model call is made.
No management API/tools/UI or Host scheduler wiring; queue is exercised directly with temporary stores.
Excerpt mode and excerpt permission/expiry integration are not implemented; policy revision is created locally (1).
No profile-level shared dispatch/budget broker yet; only a per-scope queued+running cap of 2 is enforced.
